mistral/annotations/mistral-ocr-4-1.note: OCR 4.1 card: $5 per 1000 annotated pages. Not confirmed whether this includes the $4 per 1000 OCR pages.

reducto/deep-extract.note: Deep Extract list price $40 per 1,000 pages (also https://docs.reducto.ai/reference/credit-usage.md, effective 2026-09-01). Parse included. Dense extractions over 100 fields per page may add an unpublished per-field surcharge; the generator then reports cost n/a. Credit-based accounts: no published price per credit, cost n/a.

llamaextract/agentic-plus.note: Pay as you go $1.50 per 1,000 credits. Agentic Plus: 50 extract credits + 10 Agentic parse credits = 60 credits per page ($0.09). Cost uses the credits the job reports; perPage only when they are missing.

reported.totalBasis: Gross community inventory for the municipality of Madrid, 2023: all reported direct emissions (scope 1) plus indirect grid-electricity generation (scope 2) and electricity transmission losses (scope 3). Excludes nature CO2 removals; includes nature CH4 and N2O. This is the municipal territory/community inventory, not the Ayuntamiento corporate footprint or the Madrid region. Table 9 prints 7.333,4 kt CO2 equivalent; direct-only alternative is 5.619,1 kt and electricity-indirect alternative is 1.714,4 kt. No numerical removal total or net total is reported. Other scope 3 activities are outside the indirect coverage. Direct gases use IPCC AR5 100-year GWP; indirect electricity covers CO2 only.

Gross community emissions for the municipal territory of Madrid, 2023; not a corporate-operations inventory. The explicitly printed total is 7.333,4 kt CO2 equivalent (7,333,400 tCO2e), covering direct scope 1 emissions plus indirect grid-electricity generation (scope 2) and electricity transmission losses (scope 3). Nature CO2 absorptions are explicitly excluded, while nature CH4 and N2O emissions are included. The report does not print a numeric removal total or a net total. Indirect emissions include CO2 only. Printed direct and indirect alternatives are 5.619,1 and 1.714,4 kt respectively; the direct subtotal alone is not the requested community total.

Gross community inventory for the municipality of Madrid in 2023: all reported direct emissions (scope 1), plus grid-electricity generation (scope 2) and electricity transmission losses (scope 3); excludes natural CO2 removals but includes natural CH4 and N2O emissions. Printed total 7.333,4 kt CO2 equivalent = 7,333,400 tCO2e. This is community activity throughout the municipal territory, not a city-government operations inventory or the wider Madrid region. Printed components are 5.619,1 kt direct and 1.714,4 kt indirect; these are alternative partial boundaries, not gross/net alternatives. No net total or quantified removals are printed. Other indirect consumption emissions are outside the report boundary.

FY2023 Kyoto city-area community-wide gross greenhouse gas emissions, before forest, farmland and green-space removals. Table 1 explicitly reports actual emissions of 592.3 万トン-CO2 (5,923,000 tCO2e). The headline 567.6 万トン-CO2 (5,676,000 tCO2e) is net after subtracting 24.7 万トン-CO2 (247,000 tCO2e) of removals. Selected gross boundary follows case guidance. These are city-area totals, not Kyoto municipal corporate operations or Japan-wide totals. The source unit represents CO2-equivalent mass; 1 万トン-CO2 = 10,000 tCO2e. No GPC BASIC/BASIC+ reporting boundary is claimed by the report.

Fiscal year 2023, Kyoto City territory/community-wide gross greenhouse gas emissions, before forest, cropland and green-space absorption; not municipal corporate operations. Selected printed gross total: 592.3 万トン-CO2 = 5,923,000 tCO2e. Reported absorption is printed as a positive deduction of 24.7 万トン-CO2, stored as -247,000 tCO2e. The headline 567.6 万トン-CO2 = 5,676,000 tCO2e is net (①−②), retained separately. The report defines トン-CO2 as CO2-equivalent mass. It does not provide a GPC scope inventory or sufficiently detailed transport/waste treatment boundaries.

FY2023 community inventory for Kyoto city area (京都市域), gross emissions actually emitted, before forest/agricultural/green-space removals. Source unit 万トン-CO2 = 10,000 tonnes CO2e. Selected printed gross total 592.3 = 5,923,000 tCO2e; separately printed removal magnitude 24.7 = -247,000 tCO2e and net headline 567.6 = 5,676,000 tCO2e. Includes energy-use emissions attributed to the city, including electricity consumption; not a territorial scope-1-only inventory or municipal corporate inventory.

Gross community-scale GHG emissions for Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation, for the report's 2019-20 inventory (also labelled 2019 in Table 2). Selected printed value: 46,38,344.86 tonnes of CO2e (page 3); Tables 2 and 5 print the rounded same-boundary value 46,38,345 tCO2e. Gross is a classification of the emission-only inventory: the report does not explicitly use the word gross and reports neither removals nor a net alternative. The total includes stationary energy, mobile sources and waste. The city profile lists area 257.4 (the narrative describes approximately 257 sq. km); detailed transport journey and waste treatment location boundaries are unspecified. The separate local-government operations total 73,021.45 tonnes CO2e is not the community total. No claim is made that unreported sectors are zero.

Gross community-scale emissions for Coimbatore city, covering the reported stationary energy, transport and waste inventory in 2019-20 (labelled 2019 in Table 2), not municipal corporate operations. Selected explicitly printed community total: 46,38,344.86 tonnes of CO2e (page 3); Tables 2 and 5 print the rounded alternative 46,38,345 tCO2e. The report calls this total GHG emissions, not explicitly gross; it contains emissions categories and no reported removal adjustment, so gross is the appropriate interpretation for the requested boundary. No separate net total or removals total is printed. This is not evidence of complete coverage of all GPC sectors. Table 7 separately reports local-government operations of 73,021.45 tonnes CO2e, outside this extraction boundary. Page 6 repeats the community figure but describes it as from energy consumption despite waste being included in Table 5; page 3 and Table 5 define the selected boundary.

Gross community-scale emissions for Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation, requested 2019 inventory identified in Table 2 as 2019 and elsewhere as 2019-20; calendar-year-only timing is not established. The explicitly printed community total is 46,38,344.86 tonnes CO2e (4638344.86), rounded to 46,38,345 tCO2e in Tables 2 and 5. Covers stationary energy, mobile transport and waste; classified as gross from the emissions-only inventory, although gross is not an explicit source label. No removal or net total is printed. City profile area is 257.4 (unit absent in Table 1; narrative describes approximately 257 sq. km). Geographic activity accounting and GPC reporting level are incompletely specified. Local-government operations total 73,021.45 tonnes CO2e is a separate corporate boundary, not the selected total or an additional community row. Page 6 repeats the selected number as emissions from energy consumption, but Table 5 and the page 3 community statement support the broader community inventory including waste.

Gross community energy-related emissions for calendar year 2022 on the entire municipal territory of Münster under the report's BISKO inventory, covering private households, commerce/other services, industry and transport; not municipal corporate operations alone. Selected explicitly printed total: 1.788 kt CO₂ = 1,788,000 tonnes, also printed as 1.788.000 tonnes in Figure 5. Classified as gross from its energy-emissions boundary; the report does not use a printed gross/net pair. No reported 2022 removals or net total was found. Non-energy agricultural emissions are supplementary, excluded from BISKO, and the local agricultural series ends in 2021. Source labels the main total CO₂ rather than explicitly CO₂e; retain this qualification. The page 4 footnote states that the electricity factor is approximately half national and half local, so the stated territorial BISKO boundary must not be read as a GPC scope-1-only inventory. No all-sector GPC coverage is asserted.

Gross community energy-related emissions for the entire Stadtgebiet Münster in 2022 under the report’s BISKO territorial energy-consumption accounting; not a municipal corporate inventory or an all-sector GPC total. Printed as 1.788.000 Tonnen CO₂ in Figure 5 and 1.788 kt in the headline, normalized to 1788000 tonnes. Gross is the requested classification of the reported energy-emission total, which has no stated removal deduction; the report does not explicitly use a gross label. The electricity factor mixes national and local generation factors (page 4), so this is not a direct-emissions-only total. Non-energy agriculture is presented separately for years through 2021 and is outside the BISKO total. No separate 2022 removals or net total is printed. The source labels emissions CO₂ rather than explicitly CO₂e; other-gas coverage is not established.

2022 annual community-wide energy-related emissions for the entire Stadtgebiet Münster under the territorial BISKO inventory, covering private households, commerce/other, industry and transport; not municipal corporate operations. Selected as gross within this reported energy boundary: the printed emissions sum has no removal deduction, although the report does not explicitly call it brutto. Figure 5 prints 1.788.000 Tonnen CO₂ (caption t/a); page 4 repeats 1.788 kt, with kt defined as 1,000 tonnes on page 3. The source calls these CO₂ emissions and does not explicitly establish CO₂e gas/GWP coverage. Page 4 states that the electricity factor blends national and local factors approximately equally. Non-energy agriculture is supplementary, excluded from BISKO, and the city agriculture series ends in 2021. No 2022 removal total or net alternative is printed. The 9.293.077 tonnes on page 10 is the remaining 2022 carbon budget, not annual emissions. No comprehensive all-sector gross total is asserted.
